name.en: Fake Post Office text about a parcel with an incomplete address

how.en: A text from an unknown number says a package addressed to you is waiting at the Post Office but could not be delivered because the address is incomplete. It links to a page where you are asked to update your address and personal details. The Belize Postal Service says it did not send the message.

text.en: A text says it is from the Post Office about your package.
It says delivery failed because your address is incomplete.
A link takes you to a page asking for your address and personal details.
Belize Post: Your parcel is being held at our office after 2 failed delivery attempts. Address information incomplete. Update your details within 24 hours to avoid return to sender: [link]

en: post office text about a package waiting
parcel held at post office address incomplete
text asking me to update my address for a package
failed delivery attempts post office link
belize post package text from unknown number
You weren’t expecting a parcel, or the text has no tracking details.
It comes from an ordinary mobile number with a link.
It asks for personal or card details to deliver a package.
Don’t click the link or give any details.
If you are expecting a parcel, contact the Post Office directly.
If you entered card details, call your bank to block the card.

sources.title: Beware!! Post Office scam circulates online
